profile.headline: Owner, Software Engineer at Journey Life
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with multiple years of experience implementing enterprise application integration and the development of custom solutions.

Specialties: desktop applications, web applications, java, network, database, xml

positions.title: Owner, Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Home Office, Journey Life
http://www.homeofficejourneylife.com
Software Engineer - Certified Java Programmer
- Mid-level developer with hands on experience and solid understanding of core Java libraries
- Perform analysis, design, development, testing, implementation of application code.
- Experience with Object Oriented Design, Programming, and Design patterns.
- Desktop application: Journeyman Software
- Experienced developing desktop applications: Eclipse, Swing, Java FX, Java Media Framework
- Web application:
- Experienced developing web applications: Ant, Java, J2EE, HTML, JSP, JDBC, EJB,  XML, SQL.
- Game Programming, Applets, Java 3D, Java 8, Java ME
- System Administration for (Windows 10, Solaris 10, Oracle XE)
- Freelance: Project: Journey Life (Home Office, Professional Enrichment)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Entellitrak is an enterprise-level, web-based data tracking application that enables meaningful data management, tracking, retrieval, and reporting. 
- Experienced developing web applications: Ant, Java, Java Script, J2EE, HTML, JSP, JDBC, Jasper Reports, Hibernate, XML, SQL, and Struts.
- The system was implemented with the model 2 framework, and open source frameworks.
- Provide operational support of changes and user requests for the web application using Trac.
- Independently research, troubleshoot, and resolve problems related to the system administration of the environment for the application server, eclipse, database, and configuration files.

positions.title: Sun Certified Programmer
positions.description:
Sun Certified Programmer 
  - Passed certification exam 2008
  - Distributed Web Programming
Light University 
  -  Received certificate for Taking Care of People God's Way 2008
 - Received certificate for Breaking Free 2014
  - Involved in church bible study small groups

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
Project: NCI - Cancer Trials Support Unit (CTSU) 
Developed an interactive website (portal) which processed and validated xml messages.  It was generated from the database and sent to other systems using web services and http.  Enhanced existing subsystems with current technologies. Documented logic flow diagrams and a detailed design.

Project: Specimen Tracking System (STS)     
Developed an interface to the Fed Ex API using Visual Studio and C# to send customized xml messages and automate the process.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Project: Sam Houston Electric Cooperative      
Involved in an integration project that consisted of Siebel, WebMethods, Jacada Integrator, and Orcom CIS.  The Jacada Integrator increased productivity by automating existing business processes. 

Project: Southern Maryland Electric Cooperative 
Involved in several phases of the design and development of a Retail Choice Solution.  Developed Enterprise Java Beans (EJB), Servlets, Java Server Pages (JSP), and database administration.  Created, executed, verified, and documented test cases. Developed custom deployment scripts and an entity bean code generator. 

Project:  Bell South                                       
Involved in both the business and technical aspects of the life cycle of this project. Created use cases, sequence diagrams, object specifications, detailed design, and unit test plans.  The system was implemented with Java Server Pages (JSP) and Enterprise Java Beans (EJB).

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Project: Corporate Scholars Program                      
Developed a referral system with the following technologies: Enterprise Java Beans (EJB) with the Silver Stream Application Server, and a Sybase SQL Anywhere database.  Installed the software update for the year 2000 (Y2K) upgrade.

positions.title: Student Technology Classroom Technician
positions.description:
Maintaining databases and web pages
Tracking/logging of contacts and service requests
Cable running, Server rack building, and audio visual trouble shooting
Provided on-site assistance

positions.title: Internet Publishing Intern
positions.description:
Conversions and Web Application Development
Converted Word, WordPerfect, Quark, Pagemaker, RTF and ASCII file formats into HTML documents
Converting Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and scanned images into JPEG and GIF formats
Designing home pages; developing cost and time estimates for work
Meeting customers to review designs and work plans

positions.title: Proctor/Office Assistant
positions.description:
Proctored tests for the SAT, LSAT, and GRE
Helped set up the Bethesda site
Packaged and shipped test materials to test sites
Entered data into computer
Answered telephones, transferred calls

positions.title: Computer Operator
positions.description:
Performed incremental and full backups on VAX machines
Mount/unmount file tapes for backups
Monitored processes running on Sparc stations
Monitored print queues and distributed print outs

positions.title: Textual Research Room Assistant
positions.description:
Checking of documents for reproduction
Check researchers into the Textual Reading Room
Retrieve government documents from holding room
Answer telephones, transfer calls

company.name: National Archives II College Park MD
